name: Chōshi (Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Chōshi city emblem in white: a ring with four spokes enclosing a ring, like a ship's wheel.
history: Municipal flag of Chōshi, a city in Chiba Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field.

features.role: Chōshi city emblem — a ring with four spokes enclosing a ring, like a ship's wheel
